stories.headline: Higurashi AI releases Haru-4B multilingual spoken dialogue model
stories.summary: Higurashi AI has introduced Haru-4B, a research model built for low-latency, full-duplex spoken conversations. The model processes both audio and text in real-time, enabling it to listen and speak simultaneously across nine languages.
stories.whyItMatters: It advances real-time multimodal interaction by enabling simultaneous listening and speaking in a lightweight open model.

stories.headline: OpenAI shares physics research on the Standard Model using GPT-6 Astra
stories.summary: OpenAI has published research exploring a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model. The research team used GPT-6 Astra to help translate their initial theoretical ideas into a detailed mathematical proof.
stories.whyItMatters: It demonstrates how advanced AI models can assist in tackling complex, foundational problems in theoretical physics.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches dedicated science blog for AI research findings
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched a new blog focused specifically on scientific applications of artificial intelligence. The platform will share findings, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from researchers using AI to drive scientific discovery.
stories.whyItMatters: It provides a centralized channel for transparently sharing how AI tools accelerate research across scientific disciplines.

stories.headline: Tipalti launches AP Agent for automated accounts payable workflows
stories.summary: Tipalti has announced AP Agent, an AI tool designed to handle the complete accounts payable lifecycle from invoice capture to reconciliation. The product integrates with enterprise AI platforms using the Model Context Protocol and features configurable human-in-the-loop approvals.
stories.whyItMatters: It automates complex back-office financial workflows while maintaining strict organizational oversight through flexible approval controls.
